title: THE WIRE
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: All 60 episodes of Baltimore, episode by episode — the towers, the port, Hamsterdam, the schools and the paper, plus who's running the corners and who's chasing them.
regularsNote: The Wire's cast rotates by season, so TVmaze's series regulars (McNulty, Bunk, Kima, Freamon, Daniels, Avon, Stringer, Omar, Bubbles, Carver, Herc, Marlo and the rest) aren't listed per episode — use the chart rows and the spotlight tags for them. The dropdown below is guest cast, which on this show means most of Baltimore.
chartHint: Click any bar to filter episodes. Click a season header to filter by season, an episode number to open it. Shift-click to combine.
